name: fixcrash
description: Turns a Firebase Crashlytics crash into a proven fix: a test that fails on the version that crashed, the fix, a green suite, and a pull request only with that proof.

app_id.title: Firebase app id
app_id.description: The app's Firebase app id, client_info.mobilesdk_app_id in google-services.json. Leave empty to read it from google-services.json.

project_dir.title: Android project directory
project_dir.description: Where gradlew is, relative to the repository root. Use . for the root.

release_tag_pattern.title: Release tag pattern
release_tag_pattern.description: The git tag of a release, used when an event has no build stamp. {display} and {build} stand for the version name and code, as in v{display} or release/{display}-{build}.

max_hypotheses.title: Hypotheses per crash
max_hypotheses.description: How many root-cause hypotheses the reproducer may try before it stops and reports.

max_test_attempts.title: Test attempts per crash
max_test_attempts.description: How many test runs at the crashing version the reproducer may make before it stops and reports.
